summary: This study tested how well different medication combinations control blood sugar in hospitalized adults with type 2 diabetes. The research looked at using a drug called sitagliptin along with insulin compared to an insulin routine alone. This trial has finished collecting information from the participants. Hospital de Especialidades, Centro Medico Nacional "La Raza", Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social sponsored the study.
